other_conditions: The author(s) must be faculty (retired or currently working) or researchers of AICTE‑approved institutions (Degree/Diploma/Pharmacy/Management/Architecture etc.).
The author(s) must be reputed with strong command over the subject and the chosen regional language.
A proven academic record of brilliance is required.
The author(s) should have been previously recognized for similar work.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,00,000 for original UG books, ₹1,50,000 for Diploma books, and up to ₹1,00,000 for translation, together with reviewer grants of ₹40,000 (UG) and ₹30,000 (Diploma).
